scenes.text: Every URL you type triggers this in milliseconds.
scenes.subtext: Most developers have no idea what actually happens.
scenes.narration: Every time you type a URL, something incredible happens in milliseconds.

scenes.title: How DNS resolves a domain
scenes.narration: Your browser doesn't know where to find that website — so it asks a DNS resolver. The resolver checks its cache first. If it's a miss, it asks the root server. The root server points to the TLD server. The TLD server points to the authoritative server. The authoritative server finally returns the IP address — four round trips, all under 20 milliseconds.

scenes.label: Average DNS resolution time
scenes.context: Cached responses are often under 1ms. The internet is fast because resolvers remember.
scenes.narration: That's DNS — the phonebook the internet cannot live without. Cached responses are often under one millisecond.
